name: Ortur LM2 S2 10W
tagline: 10W Ortur LM2 S2 : faster engraves than 5W on the same frame
tldr: Ortur LM2 S2 10W is the higher-power SKU in the LM2 S2 family : better cutting on thin wood and quicker fills than 5W, still open-frame and budget-oriented.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 10W Ortur LM2 S2 : faster engraves than 5W on the same frame
Open-frame layout : laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility
Work area 400 × 400 mm on this chassis
10W on Ortur LM2 S2: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Reference engrave job on this module: ~12–18 min
Reference cut job on this module: ~6–10 min
cons: This module targets thin cuts (about 4 mm basswood class) : not thick production plywood
Not the SKU for a shop cutting 4 mm+ stock all day
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W module on Ortur LM2 S2. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.
